findings.trigger: A max_lines 3 cue whose captionLayout fit is three lines at size 43 or 44 (band height h = 178.67 or 182.36, so h > 176.36). caption_board_fit.mjs lines 37-38 only check the static top SAFE_BOTTOM - h against SAFE_BOTTOM - tallest, where tallest = 182.36, so h = 182.36 is the largest band it accepts.
findings.gate_says: Approved. The gate's top check (caption_board_fit.mjs:37-38) passes because SAFE_BOTTOM - h is not above the three-line seat SAFE_BOTTOM - 182.36.
findings.render_does: Line 36 sets top = SAFE_BOTTOM - h + settle. Settle (lines 30-31) interpolates from -6 at cue start to 0 at frame 6, so for the first 6 frames of each cue the band top is SAFE_BOTTOM - h - 6. At size 44 that is 6px above the three-line seat; at size 43 it is about 2.3px above. The band therefore rises above the seat the gate enforces.

findings.trigger: Any cue for which wrapToWidth(cue.text, 850, 34) returns three lines. Gate-approved examples include a max_lines 3 cue at size 40-44, and a max_lines 2 or absent cue that alloy wraps to three lines.
findings.gate_says: Approved. The gate never runs the alloy layout (850px wrap, 34px font, no max_lines check). It validates only captionLayout's own fit.
findings.render_does: Panel rect (lines 156-157) is y = 1670 - 2*40 = 1590 with height 92 + 2*40 = 172, so its bottom edge is at 1762. The third line's baseline is y = 1728 - 2*20 + 2*42 = 1772, which is 10px below the panel bottom, and descenders extend further. Text is drawn outside the caption panel.

findings.trigger: Conditional on CAPTION_TEXT_WIDTH, which is not in the packet: a cue whose text wraps to four or more lines at 850px/34px and that the gate still approves as a two-line fit at size 29 or more, or a three-line fit at size 40 or more. Also any max_lines 2 or absent cue that wraps to three lines at 850/34, because slice(0,3) ignores cue.max_lines.
findings.gate_says: Approved, because the gate's word-preservation check (caption_board_fit.mjs:28) compares only its own captionLayout lines, never the lines alloy draws.
findings.render_does: slice(0,3) keeps at most three lines and silently discards the remaining words with no error. It also shows three lines for cues declared (or defaulted to) two lines, so the rendered layout differs from the gate's validated layout.

findings.trigger: Any cue the gate lays out at a size other than 34, for example a max_lines 3 cue validated at three lines and size 40-44 (the path caption_board_fit.mjs:30-33 explicitly allows).
findings.gate_says: Approved at the size captionLayout returned (40-44 for three lines, at least 29 for two lines), with the width and vertical fit checked at that size.
findings.render_does: Line 159 hard-codes fontSize 34 and line 153 wraps at 850, so the drawn text never uses the validated size or width. The gate's validated layout is not what renders in the alloy-loop-v1 template.
